data.long_meaning: The one who is steadfast, reliable and trustworthy. The name Saabit carries the meaning “Firm, Trustworthy” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Saabit usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, trustworthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saabit total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
